name: Adnams Copper House Dry Gin
base_ingredient: Ngũ cốc (lúa mạch mạch nha East Anglia) – Adnams East Coast Barley Vodka
distillery: The Copper House, Adnams brewery, Southwold
production: Wash of 100% East Anglian malted barley fermented to ~6% ABV
Distilled to barley vodka in copper stills
Redistilled with six botanicals in a gin still
history: 2024 | Head distiller John McCarthy died aged 55 (October)
serve_official: Fever-Tree Indian Tonic with a twist of orange zest (Gin Guild)
notes: IWSC Bronze 2020 and 2022. Six botanicals per Amathus; Gin Guild names juniper, sweet orange peel, hibiscus plus cardamom and coriander in flavour guidance – sixth not named.
